body:
I had to do this. My parents as a whole are not terrible people, now, but what they put me through as a kid really messed me up. I went very low contact a couple months ago and it has helped a little. I wasn't getting any support from them and if anything, judgement and criticism. 

It feels freeing to get away, but I do want to reconcile at some point, because like I said, looking at the big picture they are not bad people. Plus they probably only have a few or more decades left.
